faq_heading: Surrey condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Surrey condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 601 of 876, or 69%. A further 273 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Surrey?
faq.a: $435,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $370,000 and $515,625.

faq.q: Which Surrey area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Cedar Hills, at $325,900 across 6 sales at $426 a square foot, median year built 1984. The highest of the 10 lowest was Sullivan Station at $574,000.

faq.q: How fast do Surrey condos sell?
faq.a: 30 days at the median, closing at 96.8% of the last list price, with 7% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Surrey

In Cedar Hills the median condo sold for $325,900 across 6 sales, $274,100 under $600,000. Across Surrey the median condo took 30 days to sell and closed at 96.8% of the last list price, with 7% of the 876 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
